description: This file defines a DeepLinks handling system for a MacOS app using Swift. It includes parsing, validation, delivery policies, and UI interactions related to deep linking, specifically for agent commands within the app.

classes.name: DeepLinkAgentPolicy
classes.description: Contains policies, validation methods, and configurations related to handling deep links and message validation.

classes.name: DeepLinkHandler
classes.description: Singleton class responsible for parsing, validating, and handling deep links in the application, including UI prompts and communication with backend services.

methods.name: validateMessageForHandle
methods.description: Validates whether a message is acceptable for handling, checking length constraints.

methods.name: effectiveDelivery
methods.description: Determines whether to deliver a message based on link details and policy, including target channel and recipient.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Main entry point for processing a URL; identifies route type and delegates accordingly.

methods.name: handleAgent
methods.description: Handles agent-related deep links, including validation, user confirmation, and initiating agent commands.

methods.name: currentKey
methods.description: Returns the expected key for agent authentication.

methods.name: currentCanvasKey
methods.description: Returns the in-memory random key used for unattended deep links.

methods.name: expectedKey
methods.description: Generates or retrieves the stored key used for secure deep link handling.

methods.name: generateRandomKey
methods.description: Generates a secure random key for use in unattended deep links.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Displays a confirmation alert to the user and returns their response.

methods.name: presentAlert
methods.description: Displays an informational alert to the user.
